remarks: Welcome to this exceptionally spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bath residence offering 1,732 square feet at The Buckingham, a classic luxury condominium known for its timeless elegance and full-service living. With proportions rarely found in downtown condos, this home lives more like a single-family residence, featuring an expansive living area, a true separate dining room, and a thoughtfully designed layout ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The bright, well-appointed kitchen offers white inset shaker cabinetry, granite countertops, and ample storage, flowing seamlessly into the main living areas. Both bedrooms are generously sized, including a large primary suite with excellent closet space, while two full bathrooms add comfort and flexibility. A private balcony extends the living space and brings in natural light. Two dedicated garage parking spaces are included, a rare and valuable convenience in downtown Stamford. Residents enjoy a premier amenity package including a 24-hour doorman, elegant library, fitness center, community room, and a heated in-ground pool-all within a meticulously maintained building. Perfectly located just steps from Stamford's vibrant downtown, you'll enjoy an easy walk to restaurants, nightlife, shopping, Target, and the Tully Center, along with convenient access to transportation. A rare opportunity to own a truly oversized, luxury condo in the heart of the city.
